title: P1b: role-specific review, spec-review and scout packets — the review prompt receives spec, acceptance, the scoped diff, changed tests and the gate result plus security context only when a security path is touched; spec review receives only spec, acceptance, scope, dependency titles and the existing test files for the scope; scouts receive the exact question, a bounded scope tree, memory titles and the expected output structure; nothing else is injected
spec:
Phase I P1 (brief .orchestrator/phase-i-program.md, sections review packet, scout packet, spec-review packet). Base goal/T-0445 after P1a (T-0461) merges. Scout facts: spawn.run_worker renders review with complexity, diff, acceptance, security only (spawn.py:514-520) and .orchestrator/prompts/review.md has no {{spec}} or {{gate}} placeholder; spec-review and scout prompts are rendered from .orchestrator/prompts/<role>.md via spawn.render (spawn.py:75-93); the H8 packet header exists in spawn.packet (spawn.py:329-344).
1. spawn.review_packet(task, reviewed) -> str, deterministic, with the H8-style header (version hash, base sha, sources): sections in order: spec (of the reviewed task), acceptance (never trimmed), scope, diff (the scoped diff, the existing bounded form), changed tests (paths under tests/ in the diff and the acceptance-named test ids with present/missing), gate (pipeline.gated_at, gate_attempts, gate_reds, first_green_at and the last failure text head when red), security (only when a scope path matches [review].security_paths or a semantic trigger fires: the matched globs and the checklist pointer), fix-round context (only for a fix round: the parent review's comments). Nothing else: no goal history, no other tasks' results, no memory notes. review.md gains {{packet}} and drops the loose {{spec}}-less layout; run_worker passes packet=review_packet(...). Cap about 2,000 tokens with visible truncation markers; acceptance and gate never trimmed.
2. spawn.spec_review_packet(task) -> str: spec, acceptance, scope, depends_on (id and title), existing test files for each scope path (tests/test_<module>.py present or not), complexity and tier. spec-review.md renders {{packet}} only.
3. spawn.scout_packet(task) -> str: the question (spec), acceptance as the expected output structure, scope (a bounded tree: the scope paths and their direct children, capped at 60 entries), memory titles (recall index titles only, up to 10, from the memory skill's index, no bodies), the result contract (bus_post_result fields and the 1,500-token limit). scout.md renders {{packet}}.
4. Every worker row logs packet_meta (chars, est_tokens, hash, version, role) for these roles too (spawn.run_claude already logs packet_meta; make sure the meta describes the new packets).
Tests tests/test_spawn.py: test_review_packet_has_spec_acceptance_diff_tests_gate_in_order, test_review_packet_security_section_only_on_security_path, test_review_packet_excludes_other_tasks_and_memory (a fixture bus with another finished task and a gotcha entry: neither text appears), test_spec_review_packet_minimal_fields, test_scout_packet_bounded_tree_and_memory_titles_only, test_role_prompts_have_no_unfilled_placeholder (render each role prompt with its packet and assert no "{{"), test_packet_meta_logged_for_review_and_scout. Existing tests green; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0; commit with the task id including every named test; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: review.md, spec-review.md and scout.md render {{packet}} built by review_packet, spec_review_packet and scout_packet; acceptance and gate sections are never trimmed; unrelated tasks and memory bodies never appear
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
